name: io.github.meetstream-ai/meetstream-mcp
title: MeetStream
description: Meeting bots for Zoom, Google Meet and Teams: record, transcribe, summarize, run voice agents.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Clients that support MCP authorization sign in with OAuth and need no header. Otherwise send your MeetStream API key as 'Bearer ms_...' (create one at https://app.meetstream.ai/api-key). The server is multi-tenant and stores no key of its own.
